**Observation Log**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 03:04
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) is a metric that estimates the total revenue a business can expect to earn from a single customer over the course of their lifetime.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CLV can be used to determine how much a business should be willing to spend on acquiring new customers or retaining existing ones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advantages of CLV include providing businesses with a clear understanding of the long-term value of each customer, informing decisions related to marketing, customer acquisition, and customer retention.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Textbook reference for CLV: Kotler, P., & Keller, K. L. (2016). Marketing Management (15th ed.). Pearson.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Attribution modelling is a way of measuring the impact of different marketing channels on the customer journey, by assigning credit for conversions to each touchpoint in the journey.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Attribution modelling helps businesses understand which marketing channels are most effective in driving conversions and how those channels work together to influence customer behavior.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advantages of attribution modelling include providing a more accurate understanding of the impact of marketing efforts and helping make informed decisions about resource allocation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Textbook reference for attribution modelling: Dave Chaffey, et al. (2021). Digital Marketing Excellence: Planning, Optimizing and Integrating Online Marketing (7th ed.). Routledge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Social listening is the process of monitoring social media channels for mentions of a brand, product, or service, and analyzing the data to gain insights into customer sentiment, preferences, and behavior.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Social listening helps businesses understand how their brand is perceived by customers and how they can improve the customer experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advantages of social listening include providing real-time insights into customer behavior and sentiment, informing decisions related to product development, marketing, and customer service.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Textbook reference for social listening: Tuten, T. L., & Solomon, M. R. (2017). Social Media Marketing (3rd ed.). Sage Publications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A/B testing is a method of comparing two versions of a web page, email, or other marketing asset to determine which version performs better.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A/B testing helps businesses optimize their marketing assets by testing different variables and measuring the impact on customer behavior.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advantages of A/B testing include providing a scientific approach to marketing optimization and allowing data-driven decisions that improve customer engagement and
